description: This file is a localized language pack (Croatian) for the Select2 plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1, providing Croatian translations for UI messages in the Select2 dropdown.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns Croatian message indicating loading failed.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Croatian message indicating the input is too long, specifying the number of characters to remove.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Croatian message indicating the input is too short, specifying the number of characters to add.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Croatian message indicating more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns Croatian message indicating the maximum number of selected items.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Croatian message indicating no search results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Croatian message indicating a search is in progress.
